purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The municipal registry and online service are first-party and active, but parcel plans are handled through an applicant-specific request. No anonymous public vector schema, safe-ID query, or geometry endpoint was found; no parcel feature was retained.
registryAssessment: Local municipal Catastro exists, but no public city parcel geometry service was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Municipality provides its online municipal Catastro portal, including update requests, certificates, claims, and plans/maps of colonias.
Cadastral plan/map requests require applicant and property identification and supporting documents; no private request was submitted.
Official transparency portal publishes municipal cadastral information reports; it is not an anonymous parcel geometry service.
Instituto de la Propiedad promotes the national SINAP catalog/GeoParcelas; no public anonymous geometry endpoint was found.
